description: Sites d'installation d'antennes de toutes natures - Orleans Métropole is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data Orléans Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Orléans Métropole. Sites d'installation des antennes de toutes natures sur le territoire d'Orléans Métropole. Liste issue du jeu de données (source ANFR cartoradio), décrivant l'ensemble des antennes installées sur le territoire. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The portal files it under Aménagement numérique. The portal shows 360 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-orleans-metropole-fr-portal.
